caveats: globex-dell-7 (Dell XPS 15) experienced telemetry gaps, with missing battery data on 8 June and 9 June, and missing network data on 3 snapshots.

findings.statement: Unapproved software was detected on 1 device: uTorrent 3.6 is installed on globex-macbook-4 (MacBook Air), first observed on 20 May.

Two devices face imminent disk capacity failure: globex-dell-7 (Dell XPS 15) has 2% disk free (about 12 GB) with 5 days to full, and globex-thinkpad-8 (ThinkPad X1 Carbon) has 2% disk free (about 20 GB) with 6 days to full.

Two devices suffer from sustained RAM pressure: globex-thinkpad-8 (ThinkPad X1 Carbon) averaged 88% memory use (peak 94%) on 16 GB RAM, and globex-thinkpad-6 (ThinkPad X1 Carbon) averaged 85% memory use (peak 93%) on 16 GB RAM.

Four devices (50% of the fleet) fail OS updates compliance, with the oldest version being macOS 13.6 on globex-macbook-3 (MacBook Air), Windows 10 22H2 on globex-thinkpad-6 (ThinkPad X1 Carbon), macOS 14.5 on globex-macbook-5 (MacBook Pro), and macOS 15.3 on globex-macbook-4 (MacBook Air).

Two devices have drifted out of screen lock compliance: globex-thinkpad-8 (ThinkPad X1 Carbon) has been failing since 30 May (14 consecutive days), and globex-thinkpad-6 (ThinkPad X1 Carbon) has been failing since 5 June (8 consecutive days).

args.summary:
The fleet of 8 devices is operational but shows key risks across data exposure, imminent storage capacity loss, RAM constraints, and compliance hygiene.

Top risks ranked by severity:
1. Data Exposure: Unapproved software (uTorrent 3.6) is running on globex-macbook-4 (MacBook Air). Disk encryption remains at 100% compliance across all devices.
2. Imminent Capacity Failure: Two laptops are nearly out of disk space—globex-dell-7 (Dell XPS 15) has about 12 GB free (5 days until full) and globex-thinkpad-8 (ThinkPad X1 Carbon) has about 20 GB free (6 days until full).
3. Performance Constraints: Two 16 GB laptops experience high memory usage above 80%, with globex-thinkpad-8 peaking at 94% and globex-thinkpad-6 peaking at 93%.
4. Compliance Hygiene: Half the fleet (4 devices) is running outdated operating systems, and 2 devices (globex-thinkpad-6 and globex-thinkpad-8) have drifted out of screen lock compliance.

Recommended Next Steps:
1. Remove uTorrent from globex-macbook-4 and assist users on globex-dell-7 and globex-thinkpad-8 with clearing storage before disk depletion.
2. Re-enable screen lock enforcement on globex-thinkpad-6 and globex-thinkpad-8, and initiate OS update policies for the 4 outdated devices.
3. Assess hardware upgrade options for globex-thinkpad-6 and globex-thinkpad-8 to alleviate memory pressure.
